name: How long does drywall finishing take for a new room addition?
description: A single room can take several days, with hanging done first and finishing spread over additional days for drying, sanding, and touch-ups.

mainEntity.name: How long does drywall finishing take for a new room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timeline depends on size and complexity, but a single room often takes a few days for hanging and several more days for finishing because compound needs drying time. Bigger additions, high ceilings, or detailed texture matching can extend the schedule.
